PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength (Doorway Bar + Mat)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Foundational full-body strength with bodyweight and pull-up bar"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Fundamentals" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full-Body A":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_push_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row_doorframe 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          squat_to_chair 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch_full_body 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full-Body B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pike_push_up_elevated_hands 4x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          assisted_pull_up_feet_on_floor 5x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          reverse_lunge_bodyweight 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_hinge_good_morning_bodyweight 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch_full_body 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full-Body C":
